blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **ска́зывать** — (antiquated, poetic) to utter, to narrate. Wiktionary: сказа́ть + -ывать.
**гова́ривать** — to say (repeatedly or frequently). Wiktionary: говори́ть + -ивать.
**ви́дывать** — (colloquial) to see (repeatedly or frequently). Wiktionary: ви́деть + -ывать.
**жива́ть** — (colloquial) to live (repeatedly or frequently). Wiktionary: жить + -ивать.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: ска́зывать — (antiquated, poetic) to utter, to narrate; гова́ривать — to say (repeatedly or frequently); ви́дывать — (colloquial) to see (repeatedly or frequently); жива́ть — (colloquial) to live (repeatedly or frequently).
**спра́шивать** — to ask (to ask a question of). Wiktionary: спроси́ть + -ивать.
**уха́живать** — to care, to tend, to nurse, to look after. Wiktionary: уходи́ть + -ивать.
**взгля́дывать** — to glance, to give a glance, to cast a glance. Wiktionary: взглянуть + -ывать.

exercises.why: From Wiktionary: спра́шивать — to ask (to ask a question of); уха́живать — to care, to tend, to nurse, to look after; взгля́дывать — to glance, to give a glance, to cast a glance; расска́зывать — to tell.
**прика́зывать** — to order, to command, to give orders, to direct. Wiktionary: приказа́ть + -ывать.
